name: grow itemsets, pruning any with an infrequent subset
mechanism: count single items, keep the frequent ones, form candidate pairs only from frequent items, count them, and repeat one size larger each round, using the fact that a set cannot be frequent if any subset is not

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Apriori algorithm' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification:

fails_when: many database passes; candidate explosion at low thresholds
